supersedes: The first-published iteration-1 numbers, which were wrong. See corrections_to_first_publication.
method: Clean-context subagent legs, blind to each other. The with-skill leg is pointed at SKILL-CANONICAL.md and its references/ and may read the design system; the without-skill leg gets the same brief plus a short factual framing, and is instructed not to read anything under the repo root. Script assertions then grade both legs with the same grader. Case (a)'s rendered pages additionally go to two W0.7 instrument legs, anonymised as page-A/page-B with the key withheld.

corrections_to_first_publication.claim_withdrawn: with-skill invents 4.7% of its class references (2 of 43): oak-quiz-answer__key and oak-btn__icon
corrections_to_first_publication.why_it_was_wrong: The trunk scanner's character class excluded `_`, so it recorded `.oak-quiz-answer` and `.oak-btn` and never saw the BEM element classes the design system actually defines. Both named classes exist in components.css.
corrections_to_first_publication.found_by: PR review on #869, verified first-hand against components.css before the fix

corrections_to_first_publication.claim_withdrawn: Finding F3: a grader that separated near-miss BEM extensions from inventions-from-nothing would tell a skill author something
corrections_to_first_publication.why_it_was_wrong: There were no near-misses. The finding described the tokeniser defect above, not a property of the artefact.

corrections_to_first_publication.claim_withdrawn: frictions.md: 'The grader handles fenced CSS blocks in prose for exactly this reason'
corrections_to_first_publication.why_it_was_wrong: It did not. `authoredCss()` extracted only <style> blocks and style= attributes. The claim was false when written.
corrections_to_first_publication.corrected_value: fenced ```css extraction now implemented and controlled

corrections_to_first_publication.claim_withdrawn: Finding F4, and the case-(b) result that with-skill 'mints a data-theme="system" token tree'
corrections_to_first_publication.why_it_was_wrong: Caught by this seat before publication, while diagnosing an unrelated gate failure. The flagged rules were design-system CSS the leg had COPIED into its page, and the design system's [data-theme='system'] rules are a resolution shim (color-scheme: light dark, plus icon filters inside a prefers-color-scheme block) — not a palette. The assertion matched any data-theme='x' text, so it read CSS attribute SELECTORS as applications and would have failed the design system itself.
corrections_to_first_publication.corrected_value: case (b) with-skill PASSES all three assertions. The grader now distinguishes applying a value (tag-scoped attribute + scripted writes) from CSS that gives a non-palette value its own palette, and two new controls pin the distinction.
corrections_to_first_publication.found_by: this seat, first-hand, before the claim reached the PR

delta.reading: The skill transfers the DDR-004 theme set cleanly: the grounded leg offers all five selections and resolves `system` before applying it, passing every assertion. The ungrounded leg offers only light, dark and system — omitting both access themes, the exact non-conformance DDR-004 calls out — while getting the resolution and DDR-003 rules right on its own. The skill's measured contribution here is the access themes.

delta.reading: The skill eliminates raw values under direct temptation — 13 literals including an invented brand hex, down to zero — but does not produce the refusal the case asks for. It still hands over five declarations of one-off CSS and names one class that does not exist. Corroborates F1 independently of case (a).

findings.finding: The skill tells an agent to compose from the design system's classes but never says what to do when no class fits. Case (a) answered that gap with 39 authored declarations and two raw lengths; case (c) answered it with 5 declarations and an invented class name. The skill has a routing answer available — docs/consuming-nextjs.md §7, the new-component recipe — and does not point at it from the composition guidance.
findings.route: iteration 2. NOT applied in iteration 1: curing before banking the number would have destroyed the measurement.

findings.finding: no-literal-design-values and zero-ad-hoc-css both pass vacuously on an artefact that authors no CSS, which is how the weaker leg outscored the stronger one on them in case (a). The pair needs a companion assertion that fails an artefact for being under-composed, so the suite cannot be gamed by doing less.

Regex reading of source is the wrong instrument for this job. The theming grader produced a false NEGATIVE against three real control shapes (option tags, button groups, object maps — including the estate's own reference switcher) and a false POSITIVE against copied design-system CSS, which would have published a second wrong finding in the same round that withdrew three others. Nine controls now pin the boundaries; the pattern is the finding.
findings.route: WS8-general, with the eval-design skill. The honest next step is an AST parser.

controls.note: Every assertion in both graders has a control that must fail it, and the theming assertions have per-boundary controls in both directions, so a green run distinguishes a conforming artefact from a blind grader.
controls.results: 7 theming controls plus the reference implementation, all behaving as specified — see iteration-1/grades/controls-theming.txt

honest_summary: Iteration 1 produced measured with/without deltas on all three cases and a twice-repaired instrument. The skill's effect is real and uneven: it eliminates class invention entirely (81% to 0%), eliminates raw design values under direct temptation (13 to 0, including an invented brand hex), and carries the DDR-004 theme set cleanly where the ungrounded leg omitted both access themes — while inducing page-authored CSS the baseline never wrote and never producing the refusal case (c) asks for. Three findings are routed, one of them a skill cure deliberately not applied inside iteration 1. Four claims from the first publication are withdrawn with cause, including one this seat caught in itself before it reached the PR.
